## Problem

Describe the user-visible or engineering problem with specific evidence.

## Change

Describe the smallest safe change and any intentional limits.

## Verification

List the exact local checks run and their results.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and contains no unrelated cleanup.
- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior where practical.
- [ ] Formatting, lint, and relevant tests pass.
- [ ] Privacy, security, accessibility, and failure states were considered.
- [ ] Public behavior and documentation agree.
- [ ] No credentials, personal files, private paths, logs, or generated output are included.
